summary: Cleanup/delegation thunk: zeroes a run of globals starting at dword_5EA560 (unk_5EA568, dword_5EA570, unk_5EA578, unk_5EA580, unk_5EA588, unk_5EA594, unk_5EA5A0, unk_5EA5AC, unk_5EA5B8, unk_5EA5C4), calls GraphicsResourceDestructor(), then returns a pointer to dword_5EA560. operations.description: Zero a contiguous run of globals in the graphics-resource block: unk_5EA568, dword_5EA570, unk_5EA578, unk_5EA580, unk_5EA588, unk_5EA594, unk_5EA5A0, unk_5EA5AC, unk_5EA5B8 and unk_5EA5C4 are each set to 0.

unresolved: Layout and per-field meaning of the zeroed global block starting at 0x5EA560 are unknown.
GraphicsResourceDestructor is called but carries no callee evidence reference in this packet.
Semantics of the returned base pointer (why the caller receives &dword_5EA560 after teardown) are unclear.
